verdict: App installer ran without error but the detection rule returned false afterward. Same family as the APP-001 signature path but surfaced via the CM-specific error code.
fix: Same root causes as `app-postinstall-detection-failed`: the detection rule checks the wrong artifact. Point it at an HKLM registry value the installer writes (not HKCU), an MSI ProductCode (for MSI packages), or a file version check on the canonical installed exe. For installers that target per-user install, set the deployment type to `Install for user` or scope detection accordingly.
